responsibility: Implements the gcc-ar/gcc-ranlib/gcc-nm style wrapper executable that locates the real binutils tool and injects GCC’s LTO plugin when available. It computes relocated exec/libexec/tool search prefixes from the installed or overridden GCC prefix, honors a -B prefix override, finds the plugin and wrapped target tool, adjusts ar’s operation syntax when needed, and then executes the selected binary through pex so archive and symbol-table operations can understand LTO object contents.
